correctness.rationale: The specified ramified prime sends φ↦3, φ^−1↦2. My bounded replay /workspace/review_replay.py tests all 31 dual rational points for being secants and independently matches the 15 specialized normal directions; the incidence census is exactly six quintuple, ten triple and fifteen double points. Distinct rational lines intersect only in rational points; the exhaustive census proves the full support. The three Frobenius minors identify the Frobenius-fixed points scheme-theoretically on affine charts. They have height two, and Hilbert–Burch gives the two stated syzygies and shifts. In particular the homogeneous quotient is Cohen–Macaulay of dimension one, so the minor ideal is saturated (the chart argument alone would not prove that). These statements concern the reduced locus, not the full Jacobian scheme. Inclusion–exclusion corrects the sum of line counts by 59 at the same rational supports in every extension, yielding 15·5^n−44 and the stated zeta function.
